name: sipml5-react-webphone
description: Complete WebPhone application with React frontend and Node.js Express backend

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: cp SIPml-api.js SIPml.js client/public/ && mkdir -p client/public/sounds && cp sounds/*.wav client/public/sounds/ && mkdir -p client/public/src && cp -r src client/public/
